Tariq's cargo was either the canoe or the beehive.
The armchair did not go over on Friday.
Una shipped earlier in the week than Tariq.
Of Faye and the piano's sender, one shipped on Thursday and the other on Friday.

solution.key_idea: Clue 5 gives Thursday and Friday to Faye and the piano's sender, and clue 1 gives Thursday to Gus, so Gus sent the piano.
steps: By clue 5, Faye and the piano's sender shipped on Thursday and Friday. Gus has Thursday, so Faye shipped Friday and Gus sent the piano.
That leaves Tuesday and Wednesday for Una and Tariq. By clue 4, Una shipped earlier, so Una shipped Tuesday and Tariq Wednesday.
Friday's cargo was not the canoe (clue 6), the armchair (clue 3) or the piano, so Faye sent the beehive.
By clue 2, Tariq sent the canoe or the beehive. The beehive is Faye's, so Tariq sent the canoe and Una the armchair.
solution.epilogue: Una's armchair crossed on Tuesday, Tariq's canoe on Wednesday, Gus's piano on Thursday and Faye's beehive on Friday. Jonah fixed his log, and Pilot greeted the bees from a polite distance.

tip: When a pair clue names two days, check whether another clue has already taken one of them.
